Cached registry expiry dates and domain suggestions. No registrar credentials or WHOIS.

Reading needs **Read only** and changes need **Full**, unless an endpoint says otherwise. [How to read this page](/docs/integrations/api-reference/#how-to-read-a-group-page).

### `GET /api/domains`

List cached domain expiry, registrar and status.

- **Level:** Read only

### `GET /api/domains/lookup`

Look up a domain, using the daily cache.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Input:** `?name=example.com`
- **Returns:** `{domain: DomainDto}`
